decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables management unit draws directly on BSM's core ship management know-how, crew pools and training centres, so the firm can interpret market feedback and refine the service, and it fits the strategic push into cleaner energy markets.

Crew and corporate travel management is closely tied to the firm's existing crewing operations, where it has deep related knowledge, though as a support service it carries some risk of being folded back into the core offer.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship that builds on the firm's operational data and customer relationships, and the industry-wide shift to digital services makes it a learning platform worth developing further.

The mobile performance app builds on vessel operations knowledge, but the firm has limited in-house software R&D capacity and the app overlaps with the portal, so it may be merged or dropped, yet it is more likely to be kept and improved.
